build_mimo_mtp_model: build a MiMo-MTP inference model using VllmConfig for multi-token prediction with Qwen2 decoder layers
create_multi_token_predictor: create a multi-token predictor with embedding tokens and stacked transformer layers for speculative decoding
run_mimo_mtp_forward: run the MiMo-MTP forward pass with input ids, positions, and hidden states to predict next tokens
load_mimo_mtp_weights: load MiMo-MTP model weights from checkpoint with stacked parameter mapping and name rewriting for mtp layers
compute_mimo_mtp_logits: compute logits from hidden states using the MiMo-MTP logits processor and parallel lm head
